journey.name: Sleep Timer Duration
journey.description: Verifies that setting a sleep timer based on duration pauses playback when the timer completes.

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the Home screen and episodes are visible.
Tap the "Play" button on an episode to start playback.
Tap on the mini-player bar at the bottom to expand the full player screen.
Tap the "Sleep timer" button to open the sleep timer controls.
Set the sleep timer duration and tap the "Start" button to activate the timer.
Wait for the sleep timer duration to expire.
Verify that episode playback has paused and the play button is displayed.
